The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4b847d47e281e37d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. statement: Let q ≥ 2, let P : Rq → L be a measurable map to a finite label set, and let ℓ : L → {1, . . . , q}. Suppose that, on every product of finite input alphabets, each cell indicator for l is a finite linear combination of functions of at most ℓ(l) input coordinates. Suppose also that every cell has boundary of standard Gaussian measure zero in Rq. For independent standard normals G1, . . . , Gq, put SG = q X i=1 Gi, V = Var(E[SG | P(G)]), c = Eℓ(P(G)). If V > c, then finite observations on sign cubes have arbitrarily large ratios v(F)/D, where D > 0 is a cell degree bound. The Boolean conclusion of Theorem 1.1 follows by taking the sign of the final score, without a further averaging step. All partitions and observations are defined pointwise, including cells of zero Gaussian probability.
